messages:
Alice: Heads-up: scheduling a short late-night window 23:50-00:10 UTC for us-west3 rack C2. Goal: mitigate intermittent NIC microbursts and perform staggered GPU soft-reset on two blades. Targeting shared pools only; dedicated excluded.

Tom: Quick plan summary?

Alice: We'll cordon cohort C2-1, drain small tenant batches, apply IO-cap to 50% while draining, run soft-reset on GPUs if packet drops persist, then uncordon after KV-cache reseed. Expect tiny p99 blips (<2%), no full customer outage.

Rina: Capacity: shared-us-west3 baseline ~66% GPU util. We can accept rotation of 4 GPUs concurrently. Recommend batch-size 4, concurrency 1, 6m stagger.

Alice: Runbook (ops runway):
./infra cordon --region us-west3 --rack C2 --cohort 1 --reason "nic-microburst-mit"
./ops rotate-tenants --pool shared-edge --batch-size 4 --stagger 6m --exclude-tag dedicated
curl -X POST https://infra.api/ops/throttle -d '{"cohort":"C2-1","io_pct":50}'

Tom: Rollback criteria?

Alice: Abort if sustained p99 >8% for 10m or errors >1%. Rollback commands:
./ops job pause JOB-7400012345
./infra uncordon --region us-west3 --rack C2 --cohort 1
curl -X POST https://infra.api/ops/throttle -d '{"cohort":"C2-1","io_pct":0}'
I'll open rollback ticket and tag @oncall.

Rina: Cost impact: negligible, ~0.5-1 GPU-hour. I'll log exact after the run.

infra-bot: Maintenance job created: JOB-7400012345-NIC-MIT (start 7400012300, window 20m).

deploy-bot: Deploy lock active for us-west3 racks 23:45-00:15 UTC.

Tom: I'll run canary and watch p99, NIC packet-drop metric, and GPU temps. If packet drops persist after two cohorts escalate to hardware.

Alice: I'll post start/mid/end short updates to #incidents. Ping me directly if you see p99 >2% or error spike >1%. Starting at 23:50 UTC. :hourglass:
